arguments.query: code review approvals before merge to main branch

answer:64ff1153-42be-4752-9bc6-3bc229516: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:17aa3aff-83a4-4e69-a07c-307b2d7ee: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:a2539e0e-998d-43fd-a0cc-8cbf4d910: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:730cf848-5b0b-45dd-9e47-3cfa5f5b3: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:cfc5a2ac-bf2d-4901-aced-c70abcda4: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
